feature.summary: PTC V2 — persistent REPL pool with bridge-networked containers. Agents write direct Python, only print() enters context.
goals: persistent container namespaces (state survives across ptc_execute calls)
REPL pool: sub-agents share parent container
bridge networking: containers can make HTTP requests, read/write /workspace
pre-built role images: no runtime pip install
v2_changes: removed tool dispatch layer (tool_dispatcher.py, tool_registry.py, ptc_tools/)
removed ipc_sandbox.py (container-side IPC client for tool calls)
reduced IPC from 8 to 5 message types (removed ToolCallMsg, ToolResultMsg, CancelMsg)
pre-built role images instead of runtime pip install
poll-based REPL readiness instead of sleep(0.5)

server.description: 5 MCP tools backed by persistent Docker containers with REPL pool

key_files.purpose: MCP entry point — 5 tools, output capping, Docker detection
Container lifecycle, REPL pool, sub-agent routing, TTL cleanup
Unix socket server, send_execute → complete/error flow
5 NDJSON message types (ExecuteMsg, CompleteMsg, ErrorMsg, PingMsg, PongMsg)
JSONL observability for container and execution events
Base image: python:3.11-slim + git + pytest + ruff
Container entry point: receive code, execute, return stdout

deleted_in_v2: ipc_sandbox.py — container-side IPC client for tool calls

container_to_host.fields: exec_id, stdout, stderr, return_code, namespace_keys, namespace_size_kb

container_architecture.docker_cmd: docker run -d --name {name} --memory 1024m --cpus 1 --network bridge --tmpfs /tmp -v {project}:/workspace:rw -v {socket_dir}:/ptc_ipc -v {runtime}:/ptc_runtime:ro ptc-{role}:latest sleep infinity
container_architecture.repl_routing: sub-agents → same container as parent, new REPL index; handoffs → kill old REPL, start fresh REPL
container_architecture.ttl: containers expire after 600s idle, auto-renewed on each execution

mcp_tools.name: ptc_execute
mcp_tools.purpose: main tool: run code in persistent sandbox

code_patterns.description: V2 agents write direct Python — no tool stubs or await patterns
code_patterns.analysis: import radon, networkx, ast — all pre-installed in role images
code_patterns.output: only print() output returns to agent context

ptc_server.reason: REPL pool, bridge networking, pre-built images, TTL cleanup

error_handling.docker_unavailable: ptc_execute returns JSON error; agents use native Read/Bash
error_handling.container_crash_during_exec: return error, NEVER re-execute (side effects may have occurred)
error_handling.container_crash_during_idle: restart on next call, namespace lost, warn agent
error_handling.repl_crash_sub_agent: kill only that REPL; container + other REPLs unaffected
